triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA B200 (GB200 / SM100) risks the '5. `num_stages` is codegen-ignored on loop-free (single-dot) kernels' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA B200 (GB200 / SM100): 5. `num_stages` is codegen-ignored on loop-free (single-dot) kernels

problem.statement: sm_100 Triton sparse-decode / split-K pitfalls -- 5. `num_stages` is codegen-ignored on loop-free (single-dot) kernels

payload.attempted: `num_stages` is the canonical latency-hiding knob, so autotune sweeps it on every kernel.
payload.lesson: Don't spend autotune budget on `num_stages` for loop-free kernels (single matmul, elementwise). Reserve it for kernels with a real K-tile loop.

established_fact.mechanism: Blackwell's async MMA already hides the latency of a single dot; the software pipeline needs iterations to stage against.

payload.observed: On a single-`tl.dot`, no-outer-loop kernel, `num_stages=3` vs default was a dead tie (Δ ≈ 0). The attribute pipelines loads/compute *across loop iterations*; with no loop there is nothing to overlap, so it is ignored.
payload.root_cause: Blackwell's async MMA already hides the latency of a single dot; the software pipeline needs iterations to stage against.
